description: QFEP-laboratory artifacts - measuring the limit with instruments made of it.

entropy_ceiling.description: The QFEP-laboratory seam, the thesis at its most self-aware. The lab measures order and disorder, but its meters are quantized - a finite ladder of ticks, a needle that steps. True maximum entropy is a limit the instrument can never reach; push toward it and the needle pins at the last tick, reading MAX - a finite number standing in for an infinity it cannot hold. The lab that studies the limit is built out of the limit.
entropy_ceiling.name: Entropy Ceiling
entropy_ceiling.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for qfeplaboratory. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
